prespecification_note: Written and checksum-pinned before any simulation was run. The expected direction (the Hughes model may under-predict exposure at low creatinine clearance) had already been discussed in planning, so this is not a blinded analysis.
not_this: Not the concentration-level empirical evaluation proposed in the Step 67 protocol (no individual observations are available).
Not model validation, qualification or an acceptance decision. The protocol's acceptance limits remain null and none are introduced here.
Not a dosing or applicability decision for any patient.
question: Do group-mean lenalidomide exposures observed across renal-function groups fall within the range the Hughes 2019 model predicts for a study of the same design?

equations.AUC_infinity: 1000 * dose_mg / CL_F  (ng*h/mL; exact for linear one-compartment disposition)

model.random_effects: (eta_CL, eta_V) jointly normal from the OMEGA block; eta_KTR does not affect AUC or half-life and is not sampled.

observed_data.study: CC-5013-PK-001 (Chen et al. 2007), via EMA assessment EMEA/CHMP/249329/2008, pages 20-21
observed_data.design: single 25 mg oral dose, fasting; non-dialysis groups only
observed_data.statistics: arithmetic group mean and SD as reported; no individual data

virtual_trial.group_statistic: arithmetic mean across the simulated subjects of each group, matching the reported statistic

endpoints.primary: Ratio of each impaired group's mean AUC infinity to the normal group's mean AUC infinity (mild, moderate, severe). Relative endpoints reduce sensitivity to population-level differences in clearance and to unknown body size.
endpoints.secondary: Absolute group mean AUC infinity for all four groups.
endpoints.excluded: Cmax: the source study was fasting while the Hughes data had uncontrolled food intake, which mainly affects absorption.

classification_rule.consistent: observed value within the 5th-95th percentile of simulated values
classification_rule.also_reported: observed / simulated median, as a descriptive fold difference only

sensitivity_fixed_ffm.change: Fat-free mass fixed at the 55 kg model reference for everyone.

sensitivity_severe_near_boundary.change: Severe group placed at the top of its range, the most favourable assumption for the model.

known_differences: Population: the Hughes model was fitted in patients with hematologic malignancies; the disease context of the renal study subjects was not established from the extracted pages.
Creatinine clearance method and weight basis used to assign renal groups are not stated in the extracted pages.
Hughes data contained no patient below CrCL 36 mL/min; the severe group lies largely outside the model's data.
Body size of the renal study subjects was not extracted.
